acceptanceGates: service tests for every preflight rejection
deterministic crash injection at every durable boundary
physical Windows NTFS tests including sharing violations, ignored-file collisions, case-only paths, long paths and endpoint-protection interference
owner-browser smoke on the exact packaged archive
creator: Rooke Poole

postconditions: HEAD is a symbolic ref to the exact target local branch
HEAD OID equals the preview-bound target OID
index write-tree equals the target tree
all affected tracked paths match target raw-blob SHA-256 and mode
all untracked and ignored backup paths are byte-identical and non-colliding
source and target branch refs and branch reflogs are unchanged
logs/HEAD changed only by one expected switch entry
no native lock or administrative state remains

explicitlyExcluded: merge, reset, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, stash
fetch, pull, push, clone, remote contact
sparse checkout, sparse index, split index, skip-worktree, assume-unchanged
symlinks, junctions, reparse points, devices, FIFOs, sockets
external filters, working-tree-encoding, attributes that alter checkout bytes
signed operations, hooks, editors, credential helpers, shell execution
implementationGate: The read-only preflight and sealed capture planner are implemented. No execute route, owner UI control, contributor authority, git switch/git checkout command, or worktree mutation may be added until the durable transaction and recovery engine is separately accepted.

binds: repository ID and canonical root path
writable access policy and absence of deletion intent
object format and repository-root regular .git layout
source HEAD ref/OID/tree and target ref/OID/tree
index bytes/digest and clean tracked status digest
relevant local Git config and attribute policy
all bounded untracked and ignored regular-file bytes
rejects: staged, unstaged tracked, or unmerged changes
native Git locks or active administrative state
target ref drift or non-direct target ref
target collisions with any untracked or ignored path
unsupported tree entry modes or filesystem objects
checkout-affecting filters, encodings, sparse/split index flags

recovery.ownershipRule: automatic rollback is permitted only when every captured path and Git metadata item is in a known pre-state, known target-state, or known missing state; unknown bytes require retained evidence and manual inspection
restoreOrder: verify sealed journal and all backup digests
classify worktree and Git metadata into known states
restore affected tracked paths and preserved untracked/ignored bytes idempotently
verify exact pre-state and unchanged branch refs/reflogs
remove terminal journal only after receipt durability

separation.quarantineConflictResolution: separate authority; branch switching never consumes pull requests, conflict drafts, approvals, or merge evidence and never invokes a three-way merge
separation.service: dedicated GitSwitchService sharing the same repository and Git mutation locks; do not add switch directly to the v0.5.2 metadata-write operation set until the implementation acceptance gate

title: Transactional Existing-Local-Branch Switch/Checkout Contract

captures: source and target ref/reflog verification state
exact pre-state bytes and mode for every affected tracked path
exact bytes and mode for every bounded untracked or ignored regular file
directory topology needed to restore affected paths
transactionEvidence.tamperEvidence: canonical SHA-256 digests for preview, journal, manifests, backups and receipt
